identity.headline: AI Tech Lead, LLM Inference Engineer
identity.description: Valerio Giannini, AI Tech Lead and LLM inference engineer at Translated: production LLM serving, speculative decoding and low-precision inference.
identity.bio:
I make large language models fast and reliable in production. At Translated I'm the AI tech lead for LLM inference: I own LLM inference for Lara, our translation service, where custom FP8 kernels and speculative decoding cut peak-load p99 latency about 3× and doubled decoding speed. I lead the team around it, and run the large open-weight models (100–500B parameters) we use internally for coding and other general work.

Day to day that means vLLM internals, speculative decoding, low-precision inference and GPU kernel work on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell (H100/H200 and B200-class) GPUs, and measuring all of it carefully enough to trust the numbers.

I joined Translated in 2022 to work on context-aware machine translation, the subject of my MSc thesis at the University of Pisa, and was the main maintainer of ModernMT, its neural MT engine, until 2025, while moving down the stack to the GPUs. Before that I was a software engineering intern at Amazon in Luxembourg.

experience.role: AI Tech Lead, LLM Inference Engineer

education.shortName: MSc Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering

items.title: Production LLM serving
items.description: Custom FP8 GEMM, attention and fused kernels that met a p99 latency target off-the-shelf engines couldn't: about 3× lower peak-load p99 on Hopper, 2× on Blackwell, and the same traffic on fewer GPUs.

items.title: Speculative decoding
items.description: Trained Medusa, EAGLE-3 and DSpark draft models and brought them to production, where DSpark now doubles decoding speed.

items.title: Low-precision inference
items.description: FP8 in production, and quantization-aware distillation that takes models to NVFP4 (4-bit) with limited quality loss.

items.title: Lara Mini
items.description: Core team member for Translated's open MoE base model, state of the art in its size class; co-author of the technical report. I also added it to Hugging Face Transformers.

items.title: Hugging Face Transformers
items.description: Added Lara Mini, a hybrid Gated DeltaNet and MoE model; merged and featured in the v5.24.0 release notes.

items.title: vLLM
items.description: Lara Mini support with tensor, pipeline and expert parallelism (in review), and the root cause of a silent bug in expert-parallel load balancing that dropped GSM8K accuracy from 86% to 56%.

items.title: TensorRT-LLM and SGLang
items.description: Bug reports and root-cause analyses for TensorRT-LLM from production use, and fixes in SGLang's SpecForge.

items.title: Inside liteinfer
items.description: An interactive field guide to LLM inference: prefill and decode, KV caching, paged memory and continuous batching, each measured on an engine small enough to read in an afternoon.

items.title: liteinfer
items.description: An LLM inference engine written from scratch: paged KV cache, Triton paged attention, continuous batching, chunked prefill and CUDA graphs. On PyPI.

items.title: variantGPT
items.description: GPT-2 trained with seven attention variants, from multi-head to DeepSeek's MLA, under the same budget and compared.
